SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.
   C. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   C. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.
   B. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.
   D. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.
   C. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vegetation in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Eastern Africa.
   D. Say Vegetation in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.
   B. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.

12. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.
   D. Treat School and Community as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Language groups in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
